device_category.privacy_sensitivity_note: Continuous-broadcast wearables identify a PERSON more than a device (heart rate, sleep, location-by-proximity). Board must weigh privacy before minting. Argus scope is equipment, not people (Bible §11 #3) — these identifiers are device/vendor identifiers (company-ids, service UUIDs), no person-PII harvested.

Fitbit.note: No 'Fitbit' entry in either BT SIG file. Fitbit is owned by Google (2021 acquisition); 'Google LLC' (cid 0x00E0-class) and 'Google' are present but cross-attributing Google's company-id to Fitbit is a hub-and-spoke over-attribution (§8.3/§11 #8) — NOT asserted. Surfacing Fitbit's own proprietary GATT would require a companion-APK teardown, which is OUT of cohort-7's §8 source slate (BT SIG + FCC EAS only).

Whoop.note: No 'Whoop' entry in either BT SIG file. WHOOP Inc is not a BT SIG member under its own name in this snapshot. Same APK-teardown caveat as Fitbit; out of §8 source slate.

fp_and_do_not_promote: Samsung member UUIDs (0xFDDB/FD7E/FD6C/FD69/FD5A/FD59/FD4B/FD1D/FC91) are Samsung Find-My-Network / SmartTag ecosystem UUIDs, correctly held as bluetooth_tracker — NOT Galaxy Watch wearable. Do NOT recat to wearable.

Samsung SDS 0x02DE = enterprise IT subsidiary, not the watch division.
Google LLC company-id is NOT to be attributed to Fitbit (hub-and-spoke).
